author: KrustyKrew
name: ChannelGuide
short: Posts a guide showing which commands belong in which channels.
description: Posts an easy-to-follow embed showing each KrustyKrew bot feature, the channel it lives in and the command to type. Channels come from the bundled permissions YAML. Admin-only command to post or refresh the guide in any channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
